line: Bitcoin drifting flat while fear grips the market; stablecoin flow data shows whales adding to exchanges as retail ETF holders exit.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +0.09% on the day, spot ETF net -39.1M USD (Nov 11, 2026), Fear & Greed 29 (fear), funding +0.0057% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, BBVA commit $270M to Project Faro, a US dollar stablecoin venture targeting first-half 2027 launch.
Bitcoin Core disclosed three patched security vulnerabilities, including a high-severity mining bug affecting block template creation.
Russia's central bank cleared exchanges to begin organized cryptocurrency trading on Nov. 22, ahead of Moscow Exchange's planned December 1 bitcoin launch.
